result.summary: Found 1 visual issue: the bottom navigation highlights the wrong active tab for the current page.

issues.description: The page appears to be the home/discovery feed, but the bottom navigation highlights “Profile” in green while “Home” is inactive. This creates a confusing mismatch between the visible content and navigation state.
issues.suggestion: Set the active bottom navigation item to “Home” when showing this restaurant discovery page, and only highlight “Profile” on the profile screen.
